from pathlib import Path

def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    occupied_rows = [r for r in range(rows) if any(grid[r])]
    if not occupied_rows:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    bottom = max(occupied_rows)
    out = [[0] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    for r in range(rows):
        shift = bottom - r if r <= bottom else 0
        for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]):
            nc = c - shift
            if value and 0 <= nc < cols:
                out[r][nc] = value
    return out

d1i = [[0]*11 for _ in range(10)]
for c in range(2,7): d1i[2][c]=d1i[6][c]=8
for r in range(3,6): d1i[r][2]=d1i[r][6]=8
d1o = [[0]*11 for _ in range(10)]
for c in range(3): d1o[2][c]=8
for r,cells in [(3,[3]),(4,[0,4]),(5,[1,5]),(6,[2,3,4,5,6])]:
    for c in cells: d1o[r][c]=8

d2i = [[0]*11 for _ in range(10)]
for c in range(4,7): d2i[3][c]=d2i[7][c]=6
for r in range(4,7): d2i[r][4]=d2i[r][6]=6
d2o = [[0]*11 for _ in range(10)]
for c in range(3): d2o[3][c]=6
for r,cells in [(4,[1,3]),(5,[2,4]),(6,[3,5]),(7,[4,5,6])]:
